_source: Wix connector: Item SEO Tags API (STATIC_PAGE), SEO Redirects API, URL Mapping API; SEO titles and descriptions set 2026-11-07
_note: Each page has its own SEO title and meta description in English and Croatian (set 2026-11-07). The English ones were written with the Item SEO Tags API (the TAG_SOURCE_HOST_PAGE layer); og:title and og:description follow them. The API writes only the main language, so the Croatian ones were entered in the Wix Editor (Croatian view, Pages & Menu, SEO basics) and are not readable through the API: the values below were checked on the live /hr pages. Each page also renders og:site_name, og:type=website, og:image:width=2500, og:image:height=1330 and twitter:card=summary_large_image.
